- It is the overlay twin of #24563, whose in-closure half PR #24630 fixes.

Seat lean: pull it into 18.0. It is the overlay twin of #24563, which landed in 18.0 (`9f12d06770`). A list view bound to an object that exists nowhere already fails at render, so refusing it at save breaks no working app. Shipping 18.0 with the in-closure binding refused and the overlay binding accepted would be the inconsistency.
